notes.title: Exark at Tiny Teams 2025!
notes.notes: [p]Hello, operators! [/p][p]We're super excited to be part of Tiny Teams 2025, a week-long event run by Yogscast Games to showcase games made by solo developers and micro studios![/p][p]Take a look at this year's line-up of fantastic games, along with some returning favourites from past years at the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/423471/sale/tinyteams2025"]Tiny Teams event page here[/url]. Also, keep your eyes peeled for a sneak peek at the latest development build of Exark this Sunday between 5-8pm on the Yogscast stream![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45455565/da0598c8e2d3045a03e4d12e4eb6ad86a3ffe815.png"][/img][/p][p]- Robot Cat Games[/p]
